# Pylair

> Desktop framework for Python and local-AI applications: one command
> gives a Tauri desktop app with a modern web front end and a managed,
> bundled CPython runtime — typed `@expose` bridge calls, streaming,
> cancellation, crash supervision, and installable builds for Windows,
> macOS and Linux with no Python install required. Release candidate
> (pre-1.0); dual-licensed MIT/Apache-2.0.

## Project

- [README](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/README.md): status, install pins, layout, and the Known limitations list — kept honest, read it before assuming guarantees
- [PROJECT_BRIEF](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/PROJECT_BRIEF.md): the contract — goals, architecture, milestones, working agreements for agents
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/AGENTS.md): repo operational rules — verified commands, invariants, release rules, CI gotchas
- [product.json](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/product.json): single source of truth for product naming

## Core docs

- [Protocol v1](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/docs/protocol-v1.md): the wire contract — framing, handshake, liveness, flow control, error codes, orphan prevention
- [Cancellation semantics](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/docs/cancellation.md): what cancel guarantees per execution mode; a contract changed only with code
- [pylair build](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/docs/build.md): packaging pipeline — bundled CPython, uv-locked env, pruning, installers
- [Type codegen](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/docs/codegen.md): Python signatures to generated TypeScript client stubs
- [Wrap mode brief](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/docs/wrap-mode-brief.md): wrapping existing Python web UIs (Gradio, Streamlit, FastAPI) — W1 in progress
- [Ideas](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/docs/ideas.md): parked out-of-scope ideas
- Security model: `docs/security.md` exists on main as a stub; the full
  security/threat model lands via the `docs-security` PR — link it once
  merged.

## Decision records

- [0000 repo decisions](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/docs/decisions/0000-repo-decisions.md): standing repository-level decisions
- [0001 python packaging](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/docs/decisions/0001-python-packaging.md): why python-build-standalone + uv-locked env
- [0002 existing solutions](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/docs/decisions/0002-existing-solutions.md): comparison with PyTauri, pywebview, tauri-plugin-python
- [0003 wrap mode](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/docs/decisions/0003-wrap-mode.md): W0 spike evidence and the go decision

## Source packages

- [tauri-plugin-pylair](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/crates/tauri-plugin-pylair/README.md): Rust plugin — supervisor, stdio protocol, commands, permissions
- [Permission reference](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/crates/tauri-plugin-pylair/permissions/autogenerated/reference.md): the `pylair:*` capability permissions apps grant
- [pylair (Python)](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/python/pylair/README.md): `@expose`, protocol server, task runner, isolated workers
- [@pylair/client](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/packages/client/README.md): typed TS SDK — calls, `AsyncIterable` streams, `AbortSignal` cancel
- [@pylair/cli](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/packages/cli/README.md): `pylair dev/build/doctor/codegen`
- [create-pylair](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/packages/create-pylair/README.md): scaffolder — `npx create-pylair my-app`
- [pylair-ollama](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/integrations/ollama/README.md): optional Ollama integration riding the normal bridge

## Examples and templates

- [Examples](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/examples/README.md): index of example apps
- [reference-app](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/examples/reference-app/README.md): the M6 acceptance app — real AI workflow, streaming, cancel, crash recovery, clean-machine installs

## Spikes and ops

- [m0-packaging spike](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/spikes/m0-packaging/README.md): bundled-interpreter feasibility evidence
- [w0-wrap spike](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/spikes/w0-wrap/README.md): wrap-mode compatibility matrix across webviews
- [dogfood-windows.ps1](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/scripts/dogfood-windows.ps1): lifecycle containment dogfood — close, kill, restart, no survivors
- [CI workflow](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml): exact build/lint/test commands per stack
- [Registry acceptance](https://github.com/PylairHQ/Pylair/blob/main/.github/workflows/acceptance-registry.yml): pack/registry-mode install proof on clean machines
